newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steadies, focus turning to Feb materia.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steadies, focus turning to Feb materia.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were steady on Thursday in quiet physical trading that was overshadowed by volatile futures and a gradual shift in attention to material for February, traders said.
"In the physical market there is a standoff because of the high freight rates," said one broker.
"There is buying interes in the Med but the buyers don't want to meet the sellers," he said. "The interest is mainly focusing on February."
He added that a few parcels of Russian material, of about 5,000 tonnes, were available now in NWE.
A late rebound in crude futures on Wednesday buoyed naphtha swaps but then another vicious selloff today, of about 50 cents a barrel for the most active March IPE Brent crude, weighed on naphtha.
"The physical market is thin," the broker said. "People are cautious and don't know what to expect."
Swaps for the rest of January were heard up about $1 at $222/$225 and for February were up a bit less than $1, to $219.50/$221.
